title: Touhou Gensoukyou ~ Lotus Land Story - Blissful Death ~ Lotus Love (Remix)
description:
𝙂𝙚𝙣𝙤𝙘𝙞𝙙𝙚 𝙞𝙨 𝙟𝙪𝙨𝙩 𝙖𝙣𝙤𝙩𝙝𝙚𝙧 𝙜𝙖𝙢𝙚. 𝙄𝙩 𝙙𝙤𝙚𝙨𝙣'𝙩 𝙢𝙖𝙩𝙩𝙚𝙧 𝙬𝙝𝙚𝙩𝙝𝙚𝙧 𝙞𝙩'𝙨 𝙝𝙪𝙢𝙖𝙣𝙨 𝙤𝙧 𝙈𝙖𝙠𝙖𝙞 𝙍𝙚𝙨𝙞𝙙𝙚𝙣𝙩𝙨!

Back with another Touhou 4 remix (because the OST is fire!!!), and this time, it's the stage 5 theme, Lotus Love. Didn't know the name of the song until a couple days back. It's funny how Yuuka Kazami just wakes up right when you encounter her in the stage and you fight her while she's wearing her pajamas and holding a clock Filthy Frank style.

This baby can fit final areas, castles / towers, and athletic / sky stages.

Important:
There is a "!READ ME.txt" file that has the sample bank. You'll need to move what's in that file into "Addmusic_sample_groups.txt."
- "Bonus End" & Thunder SFX are disabled.
